sql.query: UPDATE tbl_generated_contracts gc INNER JOIN tbl_workflows w ON w.id=gc.workflowId AND w.tenantId=gc.tenantId SET gc.status='archived',gc.modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE gc.id=:id AND gc.workflowId=:workflowId AND gc.tenantId=:tenantId AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr WHERE utr.userId=:roleUser AND utr.tenantId=gc.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1)
